about_the_game:
My New Paranormal Life is a story-rich, erotic visual novel focused on its dating-sim and sandbox aspects.

You've just moved to in a seemingly quiet town that soon drowns with mystery and hot girls.

Don’t let the horniness fool you, however. Everything in the game has a reason to be, and your choices will dictate the destiny of more than you’d expect

Narrative

The story focuses on mysterious and paranormal troubles, with a sprinkle of humor. Who knows what awaits you in Mirage Bay? One thing’s for sure: you’ll meet captivating girls with exotic and unusual charms

Gameplay

The game won’t feature complex mechanics, excessive grinding, or frustrating puzzles. It’s designed for players to sit back, relax, and enjoy the story while interacting with the girls. It’s so simple, you could play it with just one hand!

Girls

Each girl will have a unique anatomy, background, personality, and in some cases, special fantasy traits. You’ll be able to form relationships with all of them, though some might be more challenging to approach. The choice is yours. But be careful—Mirage Bay is a dangerous place, and not everyone has good intentions.

Relationships

Depending on how you interact with each girl, the kind of relationship you build will vary. You may seek a romantic bond with some, a more daring connection with others, or even intense dynamics. They won't judge you… probably

Sandbox

Mirage Bay hides many secrets and mysteries, and it's up to you to uncover them. You’ll have the chance to explore hidden locations and special events scattered across the map from suspicious passages to hidden caves in the forest. Every discovery will come with a reward.
